# NotWhitelisted
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/utils/Whitelist/IWhitelistErrors.sol)

Reverts when `account` is not whitelisted for `context`.


```solidity
error NotWhitelisted(address context, address account);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`context`|`address`|The context for which the whitelist check was performed (usually a vault address).|
|`account`|`address`|The account that failed the whitelist check.|
